findings.issue: The bounded retry only catches DbUpdateConcurrencyException, which covers the UPDATE race on an existing official_numbers row. The INSERT race is not covered: when the row for (kind, year) does not exist yet and two contexts both take the `row is null` branch, the loser's INSERT fails with a SQLite UNIQUE/primary-key violation wrapped in DbUpdateException, which is not caught, so the very first number of a year can still surface as an unmapped database error instead of being retried. The same applies to the 5th (final) attempt, where DbUpdateConcurrencyException escapes untranslated.
findings.fix: Widen the catch to also retry on a DbUpdateException whose inner SqliteException is SQLITE_CONSTRAINT (error 19) on official_numbers, re-querying (not reloading, since the row was Added: detach it first with db.Entry(row).State = EntityState.Detached) before `continue`; and let the final attempt's exception be mapped by ErrorMapper rather than escaping raw.

findings.issue: Read_UnparseableText_IsForwardedToTheContextLoggerAsAWarning asserts Assert.Empty(logger.Warnings) while its WakeelDb is subscribed to the process-wide static DataIntegrityLog.Reported event. xunit runs test classes in parallel, so any other test that materializes an unreadable timestamp (today only this class does; a future B3-B6 test could) would deliver an event to this logger and make the assertion flake. The later assertions correctly filter by the unique corrupt text; only this pre-condition does not.
findings.fix: Replace Assert.Empty(logger.Warnings) with Assert.DoesNotContain(logger.Warnings, w => w.Contains(corrupt, StringComparison.Ordinal)), matching the filtering the rest of the test (and the Capture helper) already uses.
